Hi Naomi,

I'm Lina Ahmed, PI for the RuralComputation Lab at Connect University. We're preparing a semester-long pilot (July–Dec 2027) to evaluate language-model assisted data annotation and student tutoring for under-resourced districts. Our lab is government-funded and operates as a non-profit research group.

Budget is tight this cycle; we were hoping Redwood could provide an education/research credit or a short trial extension so we can run a proper evaluation with students and IRB-approved data. Specifically we're asking for roughly 150k tokens of generation-equivalent credits (estimate attached) and a 6-month trial window.

Attached: pilot-proposal.pdf (one-page summary + estimated token usage).

The PI and administrative contact are below:
Dr. Lina Ahmed (PI) — lina.ahmed@connect.edu
Research Ops — research-ops@connect.edu
Grant number: CU-RC-2027-08

Thanks — Lina
